items.reasoning: MSG-102 to the tenant says 8 September can't be confirmed yet, that the contractor has been asked to confirm, and that we will update her. It ends 'Sorry for the mix-up.' It does not say outright that no one should be expected on 30 Aug, but she called at 14:02, after the 10-12 slot, and the message does not treat 30 Aug as confirmed. It also asks her to tell us if anyone turns up or calls. Taken together, the message does what the item asks.

items.reasoning: There is no set_visit, reassignment or new provider in the ledger. The only actions were a request to the provider, a message, a follow-up, notes and recording the landlord decision.
NOTE-105 on the ticket records 'record 30/08/2025 10-12 (events 017-020) vs tenant's 08/09/2025 (event 021)'. A follow-up (FUP-103) is set for 2025-09-01, pending the provider's confirmation.
The provider and the tenant were both contacted by email, not by phone.
The tenant message does not ask who at the provider gave her 8 September.
The agent lists events 017-020 (30/08) and event 021 (8 Sept). It never names event 016 (the tentative Monday 10-12 call) as a separate source, so not every date is listed with its source.

The agent flagged the inconsistent names (Keystone/Riverside Works/Lantern Utilities; Clara/Ruben Oakley/Grace Mercer). It treated the ticket's provider, Keystone, as the real one and used the existing threads for contact.

items.reasoning: The agent never checks whether 8 September is acceptable for an oven that doesn't heat, and doesn't offer to chase an earlier slot.
The agent did not tell the tenant to accept the provider's date. It said the agency is confirming the date with the provider.
The question to the provider presents both dates neutrally and does not claim 8 Sept is agreed.
No date was confirmed to either party.
No second provider was assigned and no duplicate request was created.

grades.overall_note: The agent handled this well. It asked the provider to settle the date, told the tenant honestly that nothing is confirmed yet, logged the conflict and set a follow-up. It missed event 016 as a source and did not consider whether 8 September is too long a wait for an oven that doesn't heat.
